text: As the parameter r increases in the logistic map f(x) = r x (1 - x), the route to chaos proceeds via:
choices: a single jump directly from a fixed point to chaos
the simultaneous loss of all periodic orbits
a stable limit cycle that persists for every r
explanation: The logistic map undergoes successive period-doubling bifurcations that accumulate near r = 3.5699, beyond which chaos appears. The ratios of successive bifurcation intervals converge to the universal Feigenbaum constant, about 4.669.
